title: triticum fragile
intro: Triticum fragile, commonly known as wild wheat or brittle wheat, is a type of wild grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Triticum fragile include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are thought to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and diuretic properties.
